article.aiArticle:
Google and Xreal have officially entered the wearable hardware race with a surprising pricing move, undercutting major competitors as their new joint product goes on sale.

## A Surprise Price Drop and Hardware Specs

According to **The Verge**, the newly released Google and Xreal Aura glasses became available on **October 28, 2026**, hitting the market at a retail price of **$1,099**. The report states that this figure represents a reduction from earlier expectations, giving consumers a pleasant financial surprise. Weighing in at just **95 grams**, the lightweight frames come paired with a tethered Android XR compute puck, utilizing software that aligns with broader industry trends highlighted in our coverage of how [As AI agents reshape the web, Google opens Gemini and Search to more apps](https://new-sfeed.lovable.app/en/articles/as-ai-agents-reshape-the-web-google-opens-gemini-and-search-to). The hardware setup supports multiple virtual screens, offering users a portable display environment that challenges existing head-mounted options.

## Market Context and Industry Stakes

*Context:* Smart glasses and mixed-reality headsets have faced a difficult adoption curve, largely hindered by bulky designs and prohibitive costs that limit mainstream appeal. The launch arrives at a volatile time for the sector, following major industry setbacks that have intensified market competition, such as when [Meta’s $25 billion legal loss just put blood in the water](https://new-sfeed.lovable.app/en/articles/meta-s-billion-legal-loss-just-put-blood-in-the-water) for rival hardware ecosystems. By positioning the Aura below the pricing thresholds of several competitors while maintaining a featherlight form factor, the Google and Xreal partnership aims to capture early adopters who found previous iterations too heavy or expensive for daily use.

*Why this matters:* For everyday consumers and enterprise users alike, the arrival of a lighter, more competitively priced mixed-reality device determines whether wearable computing can finally transition from a niche hobby into a practical daily utility. If the Android XR ecosystem proves stable on a tethered puck, buyers gain a viable alternative to heavier standalone headsets. However, if the hardware struggles with battery life or comfort during extended sessions, consumer skepticism will persist.

*What to watch:* Observers will be tracking early consumer reception, hardware teardowns, and how competitors like Meta adjust their pricing strategies in response to the Aura's debut.

Sources: [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1020960/google-xreal-glasses-debut-meta-vr-glasses-price-release-date)
